assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a finished environment illustration embedded inside a playable indie football management game, NOT an app mockup. Style: realistic hand-painted editorial gouache/oil, grounded human-scale football culture, convincing perspective and material wear, restrained visible brushwork and fine paper grain. Palette: charcoal, weathered warm stone, muted olive grass, small natural amber lighting accents, matching a quiet night-broadcast interface. No people, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no watermarks, no split panels. No neon, glowing fog, dramatic god rays, chrome, fantasy architecture or plastic 3D rendering. Panoramic landscape, about 3:1. Keep the important subject readable in a shallow horizontal crop. Heritage materials should plausibly exist in 1950 and remain in use through a long club career. Primary request: the intimate moment of entering a football ground from a short worn brick players' tunnel at evening. Low eye-level view, scuffed dark red-brown brick sides framing the near touchline, green grass, clear chalk boundary and a sliver of the empty pitch under ordinary floodlights. Damp stone and turf feel tactile, a plain old metal gate open near the edge. Background deliberately reveals no full grandstands or roof bowl, so the image makes no claim about stadium capacity. The pitch opening is the central visual anchor. Balanced midtones with enough detail to remain readable inside a dark game panel; documentary rather than theatrical.
assets.usage: Club home; full stadium illustration with current-world stage, capacity and supporter labels
